scope: Implemented experimental contracts, analysis, evidence, reporting, filesystem, and execution surfaces, with explicit Python integrations. This supplements the target-ownership map; it does not claim exhaustive parity, migration of every mapped module, or completion of an architectural stage.
backend_selection: Python remains the default. Rust is selected explicitly through backend arguments, the native transaction adapter, or native command-line operations. Provider SDK execution and external-format import adapters remain explicit host integrations.

groups.surface: Strict JSON, canonical bytes, and packaged schemas
facade_reachability: Every native transaction parses owned JSON and uses these canonical and schema APIs.
Standalone canonicalize and validate operations expose the same boundary.
exercised_behavior: Duplicate-key and nonfinite rejection; Unicode and arbitrary-integer preservation; seeded binary64 canonical-byte differential; newline and no-newline identities.
Packaged schema/source byte equality and source-compatible diagnostics for exercised record schemas and numerical keywords, including integers beyond binary64 range.
remaining_boundaries: Isolated UTF-16 surrogates are rejected at parse time; Python may parse them before its canonical UTF-8 encoding rejects them.
Native parser depth is bounded at 900 and integer text at the standard CPython 4300-digit limit.
Exact diagnostic equivalence is fixture-qualified; unexercised combinations and schema keywords are not claimed exhaustively equivalent.

groups.surface: Typed schedules and pinned local JSONL preparation
facade_reachability: prepare-schedule transaction supports build, parse, material, and local preparation.
core.schedule_preparation file/bytes APIs accept backend="rust"; pure native-result hydration returns existing frozen Python values.
Native pack verification and runtime input preparation use the shared typed schedule implementation.
exercised_behavior: Closed typed fields, ordered parts and records, source digests, preparation descriptors, Unicode whitespace, and arbitrary positive content byte lengths.
Malformed and noncanonical inputs, 16 MiB raw bounds, record bounds, and accepted material containing 128 nested unused JSON arrays.
remaining_boundaries: The Python facade retains its YAML adapter; the standalone front door now decodes bounded strict YAML independently.
Provider loading and content materialization are outside the portable schedule contract.

facade_reachability: core.evaluation_request loader and discriminator accept backend="rust".
prepare-captured, prepare-runtime-inputs, and normalize-runtime-request operations are used by the selected Rust evaluation facade.
exercised_behavior: Authored schema/context diagnostics, forbidden include directives, mode selection, root-relative reference syntax, immutable read snapshots, planned case and run pins.
Captured pairing, provenance, work and missing-ID capacity checks without scoring; runtime schedule/policy/observation preparation and normalized request identities.
Actual source facade projections for run and import requests; explicit JSONL import followed by native publication.
remaining_boundaries: Provider registry admission, configuration hooks, and artifact resources remain explicit host adapters; standalone YAML decoding is implemented.
External evaluator formats remain Python import adapters; native preparation checks imported canonical values and their physical source digest against owned input bytes.
Malformed filesystem OS error text has not been exhaustively matched.

groups.surface: Native signed runtime pack replay and receipts
facade_reachability: verify-native and verify-native-receipt transactions.
native_backend.verify_native_evidence supplies owned independent trust bytes and an explicitly authorized scorer callback when required.
exercised_behavior: Exact-match, normalized NLL, historical report profiles, observations, independent artifact/runtime/request/schedule anchors, signed positive and rejection receipts.
Fresh score/report reconstruction; authenticated mutations of six retained evidence roles; explicit extension scorer bridge.
remaining_boundaries: Some simultaneous malformed failures still stop at the first native failure rather than accumulate every Python diagnostic.
Rare malformed Ed25519 signature acceptance differences between the cryptographic implementations remain outside the valid-signature fixtures.
Installed scorer replay requires an explicitly supplied authorized registry; standalone operation supports built-in metrics.

facade_reachability: publish-native, write-runtime-side, load-runtime-side, write-runtime-paired, and derive-runtime-transaction operations.
Selected Rust runtime evaluation passes owned six-file side material and retained signing-key bytes through native_backend.
exercised_behavior: Source-identical pack bytes for passing, failed-policy, and observation cases; fresh verifier replay; read-only pack inventory and no replacement.
Six-file runtime import authoring from records and JSONL, independent reload, canonical retained run.yaml content.
remaining_boundaries: Runtime import authoring requires an explicit timestamp in its native command request; automatic current-time generation is not implemented there.
Exotic ISO timestamp forms and all invalid authoring error-order combinations remain unqualified.
Source runtime_import_authoring APIs remain Python unless the caller selects the corresponding native transaction.

The native runtime-side authoring command writes all six files with owner-only permissions; the source authoring API may create its plain JSON files with broader permissions. Retained bytes match the exercised fixtures.

facade_reachability: Shared core judge measurement validation dispatches retained runtime-provider sources through native replay.
Native runtime pack and judge capture operations share portable runtime contracts.
exercised_behavior: Runtime specification, artifact, observation and receipt bindings; frozen-answer request reconstruction; canonical and ChatML prompts; completed/cancelled trial facts; cross-shard consistency.
remaining_boundaries: Provider execution and model authentication are explicit host adapters.
Unexercised malformed runtime contract diagnostic combinations remain bounded by the general diagnostic qualification.

facade_reachability: verify-evidence-set, verify-stored-evidence-set, and write-evidence-set-index operations.
native_backend.verify_evidence_set uses the native composition transaction.
exercised_behavior: Independent child trust snapshots and fresh captured/judge verification; exact shared run, case and subject bindings; required-policy conjunction; embedded signed receipts.
Stored-result recomputation, hosted service identities, changed pins, malformed profiles, nested evidence, advisory policy rejection, work budgets and no-clobber indexing.
remaining_boundaries: Composition does not create a joint confidence guarantee.
Exact source equivalence is limited to the exercised profile and mutation fixtures.

groups.surface: Combined reports and safe output publication
facade_reachability: reporting::sets load/render and the shared report transaction.
Source native report adapter can return public report payloads and rendered text without recipient authorization.
exercised_behavior: Authenticated component snapshots, fresh judge replay, exact combined view/facts and Markdown/HTML/JUnit bytes.
All-output destination preflight; no-clobber writes outside evidence; collision, overlap and symlink-parent rejection; preservation of partial publication metadata after a later write failure.
remaining_boundaries: Rendering does not authorize recipients or replay deterministic scoring.
Concurrent filesystem failure diagnostics beyond the injected partial-write case are not exhaustively qualified.

groups.surface: Captured comparison publication, verification, and receipts
facade_reachability: prepare-captured, compare, publish-captured, verify-captured, and verify-captured-receipt transactions.
Explicit Rust evaluate/verify adapters use the native preparation, comparison, publication, independent trust, and receipt paths.
exercised_behavior: Complete captured reports and signed/unsigned pack bytes; independent request/run/policy/signer pins; rejection and receipt semantics; no-clobber publication.
Installed public API fixtures forbid Python portable comparison/publication; external JSONL import remains explicit.
remaining_boundaries: Schema validation is repeated before typed comparison validation; a schema-only read is not a substitute for semantic validation.

groups.surface: Deterministic scoring, comparison statistics, and historical native reports
facade_reachability: compare and score transactions; coarse comparison binding; captured/native evidence replay and publication call the shared core.
exercised_behavior: Deterministic scorers, Unicode normalization, paired resampling, exact binary64 arithmetic, missingness, likelihood bindings, scope qualification, and native report versions v1/v2/v3.
Large integer policy thresholds and source comparison/projected case identities.
remaining_boundaries: Fixture arithmetic equivalence does not prove every floating-point input or policy combination.
Public low-level Python comparison APIs do not automatically select the native core.

groups.surface: Judge analysis and four retained-source replay profiles
facade_reachability: Native judge evidence replay, collection validation, source import, and precision use the shared core.
Supported retained profiles are retained-judge-json-v1, retained-inspect-model-events-v1, retained-openai-compatible-judge-v1, and retained-runtime-provider-judge-v1.
exercised_behavior: Exact unit collapse, decimal/Hoeffding intervals, precision qualification, source/trial bindings, source sharding, endpoint normalization, prompt/event reconstruction, and malformed retained-source checks.
remaining_boundaries: Replaying retained facts does not establish live model or provider correctness.
Unexercised multi-error diagnostic combinations are not claimed exhaustively equivalent.

groups.surface: Generic and native judge authoring, recipient replay, and signed receipts
facade_reachability: prepare-native-judge, validate-native-capture, finalize-native-judge, publish-judge, replay-judge, verify-judge, and judge receipt transactions.
Selected captured and runtime judge workflows use native recipe/capture/finalization/publication and independent recipient replay.
exercised_behavior: Frozen-answer provenance, finalized recipe identities, complete/incomplete and advisory policy outcomes, independent signer/recipient pins, native capture mutations, and signed receipt replay.
remaining_boundaries: SDK collection remains an explicit adapter; native admission and checkpoints do not validate external service behavior.

groups.surface: Independent trust snapshots, evaluator qualification, and acceptance attestations
facade_reachability: load-trust, verify-trust, qualify-export, write-attestation, and verify-attestation transactions.
Public selected Rust qualification and verification preserve independent owned policy/key snapshots; attestations are exposed through native transactions.
exercised_behavior: Trust profile resolution, external policy/key constraints and owned bytes; export/runner/dependency-lock bindings and canonical results.
Acceptance statement/receipt/raw-byte bindings, recipient policies, artifact file/checkpoint-tree/engine-bundle hashing and temporal constraints on exercised fixtures.
remaining_boundaries: Low-level source attestation APIs remain Python unless native transactions are selected.
Rare malformed Ed25519 acceptance differences and exhaustive timestamp/error-order parity remain unqualified.

groups.surface: Complete report views, renderers, and explicit backend facade
facade_reachability: report transaction renders captured/native/judge/evidence-set views; public report backend returns the existing typed result and optional output files.
Coarse bindings release the GIL for native work and use only an explicitly authorized scorer callback; native selection fails if the companion extension is unavailable.
exercised_behavior: Exact view/facts and HTML/Markdown/JUnit fixtures; retained historical reporting and publication failures; missing-extension rejection and explicit scorer boundary.
remaining_boundaries: Reports do not grant recipient authority.
Native report reconstruction has a 10,000,000 paired-outcome local budget; source renderer parity above it is not claimed.

groups.surface: Descriptor-backed filesystem snapshots and publication ownership
facade_reachability: Evidence, trust, reporting, artifact inspection, and execution use pinned roots/files, bounded snapshots, identity rechecks, and owned staging.
exercised_behavior: Symlink and inventory rejection, changed-file detection, streaming hashing, no-replace publication, read-only pack sealing, ownership-aware cleanup, and partial publication behavior.
remaining_boundaries: Filesystem races and platform system-call differences cannot be exhaustively established by fixtures.
The implemented Unix mechanisms do not establish Windows support or Linux execution qualification.

groups.surface: Separate execution/control, OCI workers, admission, and checkpoints
facade_reachability: Separate native control executable and execution bindings own bounded child I/O, cancellation/deadlines, paired OCI launch, budgets, durable admission, checkpoint/resume, and workspace ownership.
Selected judge/provider/OCI adapters keep SDK calls explicit while invoking native coordination; public evaluation backend scope propagation has fixture coverage in the final rebuilt artifact suite.
exercised_behavior: Controlled process output/overflow/cancellation, descriptor reuse, integer resource capacity, checkpoint replay/contention, interrupted admissions, provider callback validation, OCI fixture orchestration, and workflow routing.
remaining_boundaries: Generic native journals are not interchangeable with existing Python checkpoints; the Inspect compatibility path is separately tested.
Controlled workers are not live OCI/GPU/provider qualification; Linux descriptor execution and Windows remain unqualified.

groups.surface: Judge-import derivation through the selected public backend
facade_reachability: derive-runtime-transaction validates the original judge request and uses an internal exact-match projection only to reconstruct frozen pairs.
Selected Rust judge-import preflight and capture call native derivation; original request bytes remain bound into the comparison identity.
exercised_behavior: Focused rebuilt native CLI fixture matches source paired records, runtime/artifact digests, and comparison identity while retaining the original judge request.
qualification_targets: Public judge-import evaluation forbids Python derive_paired_records and compares the complete published evidence bytes.
remaining_boundaries: Repeated host-side _validate_import_side checks remain unchanged.

groups.surface: Live worker publication preserving original provider facts
facade_reachability: write-runtime-side optionally receives the paired original observation and receipt, validates their original bindings, and rejects any mismatch with reconstructed evidence before staging.
Selected runtime worker publication uses the native authoring transaction and hydrates existing Python result values from owned returned evidence bytes.
exercised_behavior: Focused rebuilt native CLI fixtures cover unchanged importer behavior, valid original-fact byte identity, partial-pair rejection, changed receipt image/hash/backend, and changed observation aggregate; rejected input creates no destination.

The public worker path passes with Python evidence writers/reload forbidden; source and native bytes match except independent observed manifest timestamps, and mismatched original receipts publish no destination.
qualification_targets: Whole selected runtime-side publication with Python evidence writer disabled, and tampered provider fact rejection.
remaining_boundaries: Provider SDK execution and live execution-state inspection remain host responsibilities.
The source worker adapter and real provider/OCI behavior require their own final artifact/live qualification; only the controlled fixture suite is planned here.

facade_reachability: gguf identity inspection is exposed as a native transaction and selected through the provider backend adapter; source identity construction remains the default path.
exercised_behavior: GGUF v2/v3, all 35 supported tensor layouts and one-byte truncation, scalar and array metadata, nesting and size limits, streamed hashing, symlink/replacement guards, and both context/worker-environment native routing.
qualification_targets: GGUF v2/v3, supported tensor layouts, scalar/array metadata, nesting and size limits, truncation, streamed hashing, symlink/replacement guards, non-UTF8 paths, and selected native parser routing.
remaining_boundaries: No live llama.cpp/GPU execution claim follows from file-identity fixtures.
The non-UTF-8 filename fixture is skipped because this host filesystem rejects that filename before either reader runs.

findings_fixed: Judge configuration validation precedes captured backend dispatch.
Captured scoring errors retain the public comparison-failure context.
Nonnegative integer work budgets above u64 remain valid for bounded native workloads.
Captured public SDK results preserve metric_summaries tuple type while native wire JSON remains an array.
An omitted optional CLI backend retains Python routing and original validation precedence.
Judge import preflight and capture route paired derivation through Rust.
Rust-selected workers publish validated original observations and receipts through the native transaction.
Public evaluation scopes the selected provider backend and restores prior context on exceptions; GGUF inspection uses native bounded file capabilities.
audit.observed_optimization_boundary: Captured load_inputs performs schema validation before compare_runs constructs ValidatedRun/ValidatedPolicy and repeats schema checks. Reuse should be factored through a fully validated immutable transaction; schema-only loading must not be treated as semantic validation.

verification.environment: Previously installed CPython 3.12 macOS arm64 companion wheel identified below
exercised_behavior: Captured preflight and evaluation reject invalid judge configuration before native dispatch.
Native scoring failures preserve the source comparison-error prefix and publish no evidence.
The explicit JSONL import adapter produces byte-identical captured evidence.
A bootstrap budget of 10**80 is accepted and preserves the source transaction result.
verification.artifact_relation: Passed before the latest route changes; its wheel and log identities remain historical evidence.

audit.current_artifact_recheck: Passed in qualification.final_aggregate, including all five adapter audit cases.

known_boundaries: Selected Rust runtime evaluation still runs _validate_import_side in Python, including repeated portable receipt/configuration/request-binding checks alongside required provider capability and artifact-identity hooks. Removing those repetitions requires a validated side-facts interface and diagnostic-order qualification.
Strict YAML decoding, provider discovery, resource negotiation, model and evaluator SDK execution, and external evaluator format import remain explicit Python adapters.

Low-level Python APIs remain Python unless their caller selects an exposed native transaction, native executable, or supported backend argument. Availability of a native counterpart does not imply every Python entry point routes through it.
Real OCI engines, live provider calls, GPU workloads and Linux descriptor execution are not qualified by the retained macOS fixtures. Current Unix-specific native code requires a Windows port.

retained_aggregate.scope: Native differential and retained-corpus fixtures plus experiment harness tests. The JUnit aggregate count is not the number of separately named testcase elements.
retained_aggregate.artifact_relation: Precedes the latest judge derivation, original-fact live publication, GGUF, and provider-backend scope changes; retained as earlier evidence, not final qualification of those routes.

focused_route_evidence.scope: 26 focused native CLI cases passed; covers judge derivation and runtime-side authoring checks, not the final installed wheel.
41 Python-default judge/transaction regressions passed after the route changes.

final_aggregate.scope: Full native differential and experiment suites with installed release extension, release binaries, reporting/GGUF binding opt-ins and complete source archive; no live provider/container/GPU or other-platform qualification.

expanded_comparison.outcome: Captured NLL faster; smaller measured journeys slower; higher peak RSS in every workload. Python remains default.

final_delivery_sdist.nonfunctional_delta: One AST-identical Python test formatting change and parsed-TOML-identical CLI manifest whitespace; binary hashes unchanged.

standalone_checkpoint.scope: Canonical captured evaluation; four-family verification, reports and handoff packages; strict authored JSON/YAML and setup have separate fixture coverage. External formats, public runtime import and compatibility workers remain incomplete.
